_about: Metadata-only patch for the Falcon Builder MCP server (https://www.falconbuilder.dev/api/mcp). Adds MCP tool annotations (title, readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint, openWorldHint) to all 28 tools and descriptions for every input parameter that currently has none. No tool behavior changes. Targets Smithery quality checks: Annotations 0/28 -> 28/28 and Parameter descriptions 7/28 -> 28/28.
